details:
Version: 2022.3.1-1247 (bug still present in 1249)
System: oculus quest 2
Notable additional equipment: wireless earbuds
Description of bug: The bug is that at seemingly "random" (usually somewhere between 5-10 minutes after launching the game), the audio will suddenly stop working if using wireless earbuds. This includes both input and output. However, audio still was being output from the quest itself, so it was specifically vrchat that lacked audio. Additionally, gestures completely stop working. This issue has no way that I could find to fix it, and requires restarting vrchat to fix (see updates below). In about 90 minutes, I ran into this bug 10 times. I unfortunately don’t know how to recreate it, but I think it is just from playing with wireless earbuds.
My observations: It seems like the bug happened at the same time as a lag spike. I don’t know if it was the cause or result of the lag spike, but in about 8 of the 10 cases this was present. I believe it is solely because the earbuds were wireless, which is why I mentioned them. No one else seems to have this issue, while I constantly was restarting.

Update: if you disconnect and reconnect your wireless headphones, it fixes the audio. While not ideal, it is at least a fix.

Update 2: The link to the video I made showcasing the bug can be found here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJlwDGqBItw . A bit after that, I found that while disconnecting and reconnecting usually fixes it, sometimes it doesn't fully fix it. This actually happened in the video, where cake joined *after* I reconnected my headphones. As such, I could hear them talking. The two people in front of the mirror were actually still talking though, and I couldn't hear them. It only was fixed when I restarted the game. Update 3: The additional bug in update 2 can be fixed by rejoining the world instance, but requires reconnecting the bluetooth headphones about 2-3 to make it work.
title: [1249] Major bug causes audio to completely disappear
